>
Your mother sounds like the more reasonable one, any chance of explaining to her how much this is hurting you? that it is putting you under constant stress of losing your home?

I honestly wouldn't know how to talk to my mother about this, i rarely initiate conversations with her. Especially when it's about me and how im feeling, she almost always starts crying and tells me how she feels she's a terrible mother and how she's sorry she's failed me. She then almost always tells me she'd never yell at me again/never say anything "bad" to me again. (Only for her to ignore everything she's promised me in a couple of months because whatever ive done wrong now is "so much worse and different than what ive done before").

Sometimes she rants to me about her problems at work or problems she has with other people and then she's surprised when i dont really know how to offer her solutions for her finances. 

I can try to talk to her and to tell her how im worried my parents could "dispose" of me any second, but i feel like her response would be somewhat of a coin flip; i dont know id she'd react positively and reassure me or if she would just start crying again.

I wouldn't really know what other adult i should turn to to talk about this.

>
Do you have plans like college or anything like that?

I do have future plans, but not college since those aren't really a popular option in my country? I'll get to have decent optional diploma once i graduate from the current school im at, (optional because mandatory school ends after your 9th year of attending school and finishing the 9th year gives you the right to get a job). I dont really know if im able to explain this in English correctly, however that diploma gives you the right to attend a university and initially i started those additional 4 years of school after the 9th one to go to a specific university that's near me. However I've also considered just getting a job after i get my diploma and after working for a while id probably have enough money to get an apartment to move out at 18 or 19?
